CharSet set; Set<CharRange> ranges;

CharSet set; Set<CharRange> ranges;
// a lone dash is a literal dash character, regardless of how many dashes appear set = CharSet.getInstance("-"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
set = CharSet.getInstance("--"); ranges = set.getCharRanges(); assertEquals(1, ranges.size());
set = CharSet.getInstance("---"); ranges = set.getCharRanges(); assertEquals(1, ranges.size());
set = CharSet.getInstance("----"); ranges = set.getCharRanges(); assertEquals(1, ranges.size());
// dash before or after a character is treated as a literal dash, not a range operator set = CharSet.getInstance("-a"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
set = CharSet.getInstance("a-"); ranges = set.getCharRanges(); assertEquals(2, ranges.size());
// "a--" → range from 'a' to '-' set = CharSet.getInstance("a--"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "--a" → range from '-' to 'a' set = CharSet.getInstance("--a"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
CharSet set; Set<CharRange> ranges;
// a lone ^ is a literal caret character set = CharSet.getInstance("^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^^" → negated caret (i.e. everything except '^') set = CharSet.getInstance("^^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^^^" → negated caret ("^^") + literal caret ("^") set = CharSet.getInstance("^^^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^^^^" → two negated-caret tokens collapse to one range set = CharSet.getInstance("^^^^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// literal caret at the end of the string (plain char follows 'a') set = CharSet.getInstance("a^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// negated char followed by trailing dash → negated 'a' + literal '-' set = CharSet.getInstance("^a-"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^^-c" → negated range from '^' to 'c' set = CharSet.getInstance("^^-c"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^c-^" → negated range from 'c' to '^' set = CharSet.getInstance("^c-^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^c-^d" → negated range "^c-^" plus literal 'd' set = CharSet.getInstance("^c-^d"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^^-" → negated caret ("^^") + literal dash ("-") set = CharSet.getInstance("^^-"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
CharSet set; Set<CharRange> ranges;

// "^a-^" is a negated range (not a..^); "c" is a plain char set = CharSet.getInstance("^a-^c"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "a- " is a range and "^-- " is a negated range; together they cover everything set = CharSet.getInstance("a- ^-- "); //contains everything ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "^-b" → range from '^' to 'b' (^ treated as a literal start of range here) set = CharSet.getInstance("^-b"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
// "b-^" → range from '^' to 'b' (reversed endpoints are normalized) set = CharSet.getInstance("b-^"); ranges = set.getCharRanges();
